in_sanskrit.name: अर्यव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Aryav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arya' which means noble, virtuous, or respectable. The suffix 'av' is a common Sanskrit suffix that denotes a male person or a possessor. Therefore, Aryav can be translated as 'nobleman' or 'virtuous man'.

The second part of the name, 'व (v)', is a consonant that can represent various sounds in Hindi. It is often used as a suffix to denote possession or to form compound words. In this context, it may represent the idea of 'having' or 'possessing' nobility or virtue.
